Win the room before a guest finds a rival

A traveller searching “hotels near me” is on the road, often on an iPhone, and the map answers differently from the airport, the highway and the city centre. Every search that ranks another property first is a booking — and the whole stay — gone. A single rank from your desk can’t see any of it. Eagle Eye shows where you rank from every place guests arrive, on Google and Apple Maps alike, so you win the room instead of the hotel next door.

Rank from every arrival point

  • Rank across the whole travel area — a grid over the airport, the stations and the sights, not one position.
  • Both maps, side by side — travellers lean on Apple as much as Google; run both and compare.
  • ARP — how high the hotel places where it appears across that area.
  • A competitor map per rival — the properties winning the searches from where your guests land.

Start free: 10 scans, a free first scan of your own hotel up to 21 × 21, and credits that never expire. Track both surfaces on Apple Maps — then see the plans.

Three numbers, every scan

The whole grid rolls up into the figures a client actually remembers — tracked every run so the trend is the proof.

LSOVLocal Share of Voice

How much of the whole grid finds the business near the top — one number for the entire map.

ARPAverage Rank, found

The mean position across only the points that return the business at all.

ATRPAverage Total Rank

The same average, counting every point that missed the business entirely — the honest one.

Questions, answered

How does Eagle Eye help a hotel rank locally?

It maps the hotel’s rank from every place guests arrive — the airport, the stations, the city centre — on Google and Apple Maps, so you win the room instead of losing it to the property next door.

Why track Apple Maps for a hotel?

Travellers lean on Apple Maps as much as Google. Eagle Eye runs both at the same price, so you measure the whole travel surface, not half of it.

Can I see which properties win searches from where guests land?

Eagle Eye draws a competitor map for every rival that outranks you — their rank at every point of the same grid — so you see exactly which competitor wins each block, not just that you place #5.

How high does my hotel place across the area?

ARP gives your average rank across the points where the hotel appears in the top 20, over the whole travel area.

Is there a free scan to start?

A new organisation starts with 10 free scans, and your first scan of your own website is free at any size up to 21 × 21 — no card needed.

Find out where you really rank

Your first scan of your own site is free, at any grid size. No card needed.
